services.name: The Aquarium
services.desc: Fish Tank Promotions is proud to present Los Angeles-based experimental noise rock outfit Shearling with Shrive and Gardersnake at The Aquarium in Fargo on Saturday, September 26. Serving as a spiritual continuation of the now-defunct Sprain, Shearling exhibits the reunion of a now decade-old collaborative force between guitarists Alexander Kent and Sylvie Simmons. A subsequent recruiting of percussionist Andrew Chanover, bassist Wesley Nelson, and Keyboardist Elizabeth Carver filled out their orchestrally minded roster. blurb: The Aquarium is North Dakota’s #1 live music venue. Located in the heart of downtown Fargo, our venue hosts more national, regional and local bands and artists than any other place in the state. Past headliners include Father John Misty, Bon Iver, The Melvins, Prof, Built To Spill, Band of Horses, Trampled By Turtles and hundreds of other acclaimed acts. The Aquarium is independently owned and operated.
